Bug_Details:
An object is compared to itself The arguments to compareTo method are the same object, so it always returns 0.
Either change the arguments to point to different objects or substitute 0.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the compareTo method. The object is compared to itself, which always returns 0.
Trigger_Explanation: The testSelfComparisonBug method compares a SelfComparisonBug object to another SelfComparisonBug object with a different value. Since the bug is that comparing an object to itself always returns 0, the test fails when it expects the comparison to not return 0.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the comparison between buggyObj and otherObj returns a non-zero value, which indicates that the self-comparison bug was not triggered in this test case.
